title: Transcription Reconciliation, Double-Keying & Error Rate Evaluation
query: What methods and metrics, such as double-keying and character/word error rate (CER/WER) calculation, govern the reconciliation of manual, HTR, and AI-generated manuscript transcriptions into a consensus text?

results.title: A review of artificial intelligence in herbarium specimen image analysis
results.authors_venue_year: A review of artificial intelligence in herbarium specimen image analysisYY Guo, H Cai, GLC Bramley, HJ Atkins, B Li… - Artificial Intelligence …, 2025 - SpringerExplains that transcription quality, after Optical Character Recognition (OCR) or Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR), is measured using the Character Error Rate (CER), a standard metric in automatic speech and text recognition.Transcription Pipeline Steps: Details that automated label transcription in modern pipelines is a multi-step process involving locating and classifying labels, applying OCR or HTR, and performing post-processing, often using Large Language Models (LLMs), for correction and formatting.Human Validation Strategy: Mentions that low-confidence detections or conflicting records from automated extraction are routed to experts or volunteers for manual review, verification, and normalization, demonstrating a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) quality assurance strategy.Save Cite Cited by 2 Related articles All 6 versions  [PDF] acm.orgFull View
